run_update_pkls: run update_pkls to migrate adsorbates and bulks pickle files from ASE v3.19 to v3.21
run_update_dbs: run update_dbs to migrate adsorbates and bulks ASE database files from v3.19 to v3.21
run_update_script: run the main update script to migrate all ASE pickle and database files to v3.21
review_pbc_patch: review the pbc_patch monkey patch that adds a pbc property getter to ASE Atoms objects
review_set_pbc_patch: review the set_pbc_patch monkey patch that adds a set_pbc setter to ASE Atoms objects
